FAQ

Questions clients ask first

Where are you based, and who do you work with?

I work fully online with clients worldwide — especially businesses in the United States. Communication is in clear English, and I adjust my schedule for updates across time zones. To reach me, use any of the options in the Contact Me section below — email, WhatsApp, Facebook, TikTok or phone.

How much does a project cost?

It depends on the service and scope, which is why I quote every project individually and in writing before starting — no hidden charges. Use the brief builder below and I'll reply with a clear price and timeline.

I'm not sure which service I need. Can you advise?

Absolutely — that's part of the job. Tell me your goal (more sales, more followers, a new website) in the brief, and I'll recommend the simplest package that fits, even if it's the smallest one.

How do payments work?

I can work through Fiverr for full buyer protection, or direct payment via Payoneer — whichever you're more comfortable with. We'll agree everything before any work begins.

What do you need from me to start?

Just your business name, links to your current pages (if any), and your goal. Logos, photos or brand colors help with design work, but if you don't have them yet, I can create a clean starting style for you.

Can I see a sample before ordering?

Yes. For design and content projects I'm happy to make one sample piece in your brand style first, so you know exactly what to expect.
